why: R5 latency: one VM at a time (PARALLEL_VMS=1), arms run serially. Phase 1/2 ran two VMs in parallel, so their wall times are not latency data. Cells: a text read (T1 canvas), a click (T5 canvas), an image read (T3-invoice image), a DOM baseline (T2-order dom). Daemon-side per-call times are in each job audit (dur_ms, sck_ms, vision_ms).
